# Infinite Care Beauty Clinic

> Beauty and aesthetic clinic in Budapest (Bp. VI. Podmaniczky str. 5.). Treatments such as microneedling, laser hair removal, EMSCULPT and teeth whitening. The website is available in English and Hungarian.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.infinitecare.hu/): clinic introduction, photo gallery, treatment videos and the contact form
- [Our treatments](https://www.infinitecare.hu/services): all treatments
- [Blog](https://www.infinitecare.hu/blog): articles about treatments and skin care
- [Exosome Therapy](https://www.infinitecare.hu/exosome-therapy): Exosome therapy at Infinite Care Beauty Clinic, Budapest: reduced inflammation, improved tissue repair and enhanced collagen production for wrinkles, pigmentation, scars and scalp problems.
- [Laser hair removal](https://www.infinitecare.hu/laser-hair-removal): Painless, permanent laser hair removal with our brand new laser machine in Budapest. Visible results after the first few treatments. Before and after care tips.
- [Mesotherapy with micro needles](https://www.infinitecare.hu/mesotherapy): Mesotherapy is a non-surgical technique that delivers vitamins, plant extracts and other ingredients into the skin with micro needles. Revitalize serums for skin, body and hair in Budapest.
- [Emsculpt treatment](https://www.infinitecare.hu/ems-treatment): EMSCULPT treatment: build muscle and burn fat with electric muscle stimulation (EMS). Faster results than conventional training, with no load on your joints. Budapest.
- [Cellulite therapy](https://www.infinitecare.hu/cellulite-therapy): Anti-cellulite treatment for a flawless body with radio frequency, infrared and vacuum (U Shaping) for smoother, tighter skin. Budapest.
- [Carbon peeling](https://www.infinitecare.hu/carbon-peeling): Anti-aging carbon peeling with laser for a perfectly tight and wrinkle free face. Ideal for scars and oily, uneven skin. Infinite Care Beauty Clinic, Budapest.
- [Teeth whitening](https://www.infinitecare.hu/teeth-whitening): Hollywood smile without pain in 60 minutes with our latest laser teeth whitening machine. How the treatment works. Infinite Care Beauty Clinic, Budapest.
- [Face lifting](https://www.infinitecare.hu/face-lifting-en): Non-surgical facelifting: radio frequency skin tightening with infrared and vacuum stimulates collagen, elastin and new skin cells to firm and lift sagging skin. Budapest.
- [Brazilift](https://www.infinitecare.hu/brazilift-en): Brazilift: our buttocks and breast treatment with vacuum for a more plumped, tighter body. Painless Brazilian lift at Infinite Care Beauty Clinic, Budapest.
